subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar own a first-class, persistent external-command hook surface in shared config, Settings, and CLI?
rationale: This is a substantial new automation capability with a deliberate local code-execution boundary, not an established bug fix or routine provider extension.

options.title: Accept after argv repair
options.body: Keep the full Settings, CLI, and config feature after argument arrays round-trip losslessly and focused coverage is added.

options.title: Narrow initial surface
options.body: Ship only explicit config and CLI test/list support, deferring the Settings rule editor until its representation and UX are settled.

options.title: Decline command execution
options.body: Keep CodexBar observability-only and leave external reactions to downstream polling or tools.

recommendation.title: Accept after argv repair
recommendation.body: Keep the full Settings, CLI, and config feature after argument arrays round-trip losslessly and focused coverage is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership makes this account the best available owner for accepting or declining a new application-level execution boundary.
